summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SOCLE Artisan – Assistant Devis IA. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass including real Emergent LLM gpt-5.4 AI analyze call. Frontend: Dashboard, Quotes list with all filter chips, Quote detail preview, Relance modal with prefilled message, Send/Accept status transitions, New Quote wizard with prefill/example/analyze/edit/add-line/save flow all work end-to-end.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> (from an auto-injected instrumentation wrapper). Non-blocking but pollutes console. Consider forcing plain text children for <option> to silence warning.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/analyze uses model 'openai/gpt-5.4' - works via emergentintegrations, response parsed with regex/JSON extraction (robust).
next_numero() uses count_documents which can collide if quotes are deleted or created concurrently; consider using a counter/uuid-based sequence for production.
seed_if_empty runs at startup and force /api/seed exists (deletes all quotes) - fine for MVP but should be admin-guarded.
QuotesList uses default filter key '' but data-testid is 'filter-all' (per FILTERS key||'all'). Consistent, but /quotes route does not exist (only /devis) - keep in mind for docs.
Frontend LineEditor generates React hydration warning about span inside option; low severity.
seed_data_creation: Test flow created DEV-2026-005 (via save-quote-button in wizard) and transitioned DEV-2026-004 through envoye→accepte. Seed data (DEV-2026-001 to 004) remains intact. Additional TEST_ quotes created via pytest CRUD flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and all documented data-testid selectors work. Frontend routes are: /, /devis, /devis/:id, /nouveau (note: NOT /quotes). Filter chip IDs are filter-all/brouillon/envoye/a_relancer/accepte. QuoteDetail can take ~1s to fetch — always wait_for_selector on [data-testid='quote-preview']. AI analyze takes 5-15s (wait 30s for line-editor). To reset seed data: POST /api/seed.
